name: Facet
text: Choose the floating collapsed legend. It hides until needed, preserving screen space while keeping the legend accessible. The trade-off is a slight delay when first opening it, but this beats cluttering the graph with a permanent panel that blocks data.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A floating collapsed icon still risks users missing it entirely if the graph’s data density distracts them—permanent panels are ugly but predictable. Better: a thin, anchored sidebar that collapses to a tab, balancing space and discoverability; test both with 5 users timing how long they take to find the legend.
